The '''Oovo system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Tharin sector/Legends|Tharin sector]]. This system contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Oovo]], along with the [[Star/Legends|star]] that [[Oovo]] orbits, the [[Moon/Legends|moon]]-[[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]] of [[Oovo IV/Legends|Oovo IV]].
